purpose: Exact-acceleration candidate: precompute each candidate state's direct macro set, executable transitive lineage set, and expanded depth/node cost once per state instead of recomputing them for each dominance comparison.
exactness_contract: No changes to candidate generation, rank order, expression canonicalization, dominance predicate, or frontiers before a diagnostic work cutoff.
The direct macro attribute is frozenset(state[2]); the lineage attribute reuses the exact executable lineage set already computed at state registration.
Expanded cost is computed with the same executable_cost(expr) routine already used by the reference predicate.
Decision-trace parity must be measured against D; fewer time/counter cost is not by itself sufficient.
